newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Charles County, Md..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Charles County
Maryland
County Commissioners of Charles County
Consolidated Public Improvement Bonds of 1997
SEALEDBIDSwill be received by the Board of County

Commissioners of Charles County at the offices of The First National Bank of Maryland, Twelfth Floor Conference Room, 25 South Charles Street, Baltimore, Maryland, until 1:00 p.m. (EST) on for the purchase of the above-referenced general obligation bonds of the County Commissioners of Charles County (the County''), aggregating $19,400,000, all bearing interest payable on August 1, 1997 (five and one-half months), and semiannually thereafter on February 1 and August 1 until maturity or earlier redemption, and maturing, subject to prior redemption as herein stated, on February 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

2002 1,000,000 2007 1,400,000 2012 1,900,000 Bonds that mature on or before February 1, 2007, are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities. The bonds which mature on and after February 1, 2008, are subject to redemption beginning February 1, 2007, as a whole or in part on any date thereafter, at the option of the County, after at least thirty (30) days' notice by

publication, at a redemption price for each bond redeemed equal to a percentage of the principal amount of such bond to be redeemed as set forth in the following table, plus accrued interest to the redemption date:
Redemption Period
(both dates inclusive) Redemption Price
February 1, 2007 to January 31, 2008 101%
February 1, 2008 to January 31, 2009 100.5%
February 1, 2009 and thereafter 100%

The bonds will be issued under the authority of Chapter 61 of the Laws of Maryland of 1995 and Section 97-1 of the Code of Charles County (1994 Edition) and a Resolution of the Board of County Commissioners of Charles County adopted on January 28, 1997. The net proceeds of these bonds, together with funds from other sources, will be used to provide financing for the acquisition, planning, design,
engineering, construction, renovation, expansion and
equipping of certain public buildings, facilities, equipment and grounds in Charles County, Maryland.

Bidders must bid at least par for the bonds and must specify the rate or rates of interest to be paid thereon in multiples of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1%. Bidders may specify more than one rate of interest but not more than one interest rate for any maturity, nor a zero rate. The difference

between the maximum and minimum interest rates so spec may not be greater than 2%. The bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering the lowest true interest cost to the County, such interest cost to be determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method by doubling the semi-annual interest rate (compounded semi-annually) necessary to
discount the debt service payments from the payment dates to the date of the bonds and to the price bid, excluding interest accrued to the date of delivery.
The bonds will be issued in fully registered book-entry form. The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, will act as securities depository for the bonds.

The bonds are general obligation bonds of the County, and will constitute an irrevocable pledge of its full faith and credit and unlimited taxing power. The issuance of such bonds will be subject to approval of legality by Smith, Somerville & Case, L.L.C., Baltimore, Maryland, Bond
Counsel, and copies of their opinion will be delivered, without charge, to the purchaser
The Preliminary Official Statement concerning this sale of

bonds, the official Notice of Sale and the required form of proposal will be supplied to prospective bidders upon request made in writing to the financial advisor for the issuance of the bonds, H.C. Wainwright & Co., Inc., 100 E. Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202, or by telephone (410) 347-3900.
The right is reserved to reject any and all bids.
By order of
Board of County Commissioners of Charles County
By: Murray D. Levy, President
County Commissioners of Charles County
(From The Bond Buyer)
